latency.complaint_creation_p99: < 2,000ms from form submission to ComplaintCase created

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.9% — complaint submission must be available 24/7; customers may have urgent issues outside business hours

security.data_classification: PII — complaint contains customer identity, account reference, and description of issue
security.access_control: Customer authenticated via channel session (SCA not required for complaint submission)
security.audit: All complaint submissions logged immutably in SVC-103

latency.portal_load_p95: < 1,500ms for complaint list and customer account summary

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.5% — internal portal; business hours primary usage

security.access_control: Role-gated to PER-062 and PER-052; case assignment restricted to authorised staff
security.audit: All triage actions logged with timestamp and agent ID

latency.transaction_history_retrieval_p95: < 3,000ms for up to 12 months account history

security.access_control: Assigned agent only for investigation notes; redress authorisation requires delegated authority check
security.audit: Investigation notes, outcome decisions, and redress amounts logged immutably

latency.response_dispatch: Same business day as resolution decision
latency.fos_referral_response_sla: Within FOS-mandated timeframes (typically 28 days for initial response)

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.9% — notification dispatch must be reliable; missed communications are a DISP breach

security.data_classification: PII — letter content contains resolution decision and account details
security.access_control: System-generated communications reviewed by PER-062 before dispatch for Final Response Letters
security.audit: Communication dispatch events logged; delivery confirmation recorded

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Complaint Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: ComplaintCase records and all associated audit logs retained for minimum 3 years (DISP 1.9.1R). Extended retention for FOS-referred complaints for the duration of the FOS investigation plus 1 year.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: DISP 1.9.1R mandates 3-year retention for retail complaints. Longer retention for FOS cases supports legal defence.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: DISP Reporting Data Completeness
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: 100% of complaints received must be captured in the DISP half-yearly reporting dataset. No complaint may be silently lost or excluded from regulatory reporting.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: FCA requires complete and accurate DISP reporting. Incomplete reporting is a regulatory breach.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Complaint Throughput
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: System must support processing of up to 5,000 complaints per day during peak periods (e.g. following a major service incident affecting many customers).
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: Service incidents generate complaint spikes. The complaint system must scale to handle incident-driven volumes without degrading SLA compliance.

regulatory_slas.name: DISP 1.6 — Prompt Acknowledgement
regulatory_slas.requirement: Acknowledge complaint promptly — within 1 business day of receipt

regulatory_slas.name: DISP 1.6 — Summary Resolution (3 Business Days)
regulatory_slas.requirement: For complaints resolvable within 3 business days, issue Summary Resolution Communication on resolution
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Full Final Response Letter required; FOS referral rights must be triggered

regulatory_slas.name: DISP 1.6 — Final Response (8 Weeks)
regulatory_slas.requirement: Issue Final Response Letter within 8 weeks of complaint receipt, including FOS referral rights and 6-month referral window
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Regulatory breach; FOS referral right becomes immediate; potential fine and supervisory action

regulatory_slas.name: DISP 1.10 — Half-Yearly Reporting
regulatory_slas.requirement: Report complaint volumes, outcomes, and root causes to FCA every 6 months
